typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DatabaseId as string ()
}

source(output(
		DatabaseName as string,
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		SchemaName as string,
		IS_NULLABLE as boolean,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	isolationLevel: 'READ_UNCOMMITTED',
	query: '/* INSERT INTO  [YodilIDS_Map2Code].[ETL].[TableMeta]            ([DatabaseName]            ,[TargetTable]            ,[TargetColumn]            ,[TargetSchema]            ,[MaxLen]            ,[DataType]            ,[CharacterMaximumLength])   */ select cast(DB_NAME() as nvarchar(50))as DatabaseName,  Cast(t.name as nvarchar(75)) as  TableName , Cast(c.name as nvarchar(75)) as  ColumnName  ,cast( s.name as nvarchar(50))as  SchemaName	  ,c.IS_NULLABLE ,Cast(\'C\' as nchar(1)) as TableColumnValueFlag   		   from sys.columns C 	inner join sys.objects O  		   	 ON C.object_id=O.object_id	join  sys.TABLES t 	 			   on o.object_id = t.object_id  and o.schema_id = t.schema_id	 			   join sys.schemas s on t.schema_id = s.schema_id 			    join  information_schema.columns h	  				on t.name = h.TABLE_NAME and h.COLUMN_NAME = c.name  				and h.TABLE_SCHEMA = s.name   Union    select cast(DB_NAME() as nvarchar(50))as DatabaseName,    Cast(t.name as nvarchar(75)) as  TableName   , Cast(c.name as nvarchar(75)) as  ColumnName      ,cast( s.name as nvarchar(50))as  SchemaName	 	  	  				 ,c.IS_NULLABLE ,Case when s.name = \'dim\' then \'C\'  		when t.name = \'ClaimOpen\' then \'C\'  else Cast(\'W\' as nchar(1)) End as TableColumnValueFlag  /* V represents special name value pair in the mart otherwise W for regualar view */ 			from sys.columns C 	 		   inner join sys.objects O  		   	 ON C.object_id=O.object_id	 			join  sys.views t 	 		   on o.object_id = t.object_id  and o.schema_id = t.schema_id	 			join sys.schemas s  			on t.schema_id = s.schema_id 			 join  information_schema.columns h	  				on t.name = h.TABLE_NAME and h.COLUMN_NAME = c.name  				and h.TABLE_SCHEMA = s.name  				 Union 	 SELECT distinct cast(DB_NAME() as nvarchar(50))as DatabaseName    , Cast(t.name as nvarchar(75)) as  TableName   ,Null as ColumnName     ,cast( s.name as nvarchar(50))as  SchemaName	      		 ,Null 	 ,Cast(\'T\' as nchar(1)) as TableColumnValueFlag 	   FROM sys.tables AS t   INNER JOIN sys.schemas AS s   ON t.[schema_id] = s.[schema_id]    Union 	 SELECT distinct cast(DB_NAME() as nvarchar(50))as DatabaseName    , Cast(t.name as nvarchar(75)) as  TableName   ,Null as ColumnName     ,cast( s.name as nvarchar(50))as  SchemaName	      		 ,Null 	 ,Cast(\'I\' as nchar(1)) as TableColumnValueFlag 	    			from sys.columns C 	 		   inner join sys.objects O  		   	 ON C.object_id=O.object_id	 			join  sys.views t 	 		   on o.object_id = t.object_id  and o.schema_id = t.schema_id	 			join sys.schemas s  			on t.schema_id = s.schema_id 			 join  information_schema.columns h	  				on t.name = h.TABLE_NAME and h.COLUMN_NAME = c.name  				and h.TABLE_SCHEMA = s.name  				;',
	format: 'query',
	staged:false) ~> SRCLoadETLMetadata
SRCLoadETLMetadata derive(DatabaseId = $DatabaseId) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		IsNullable as boolean,
		DatabaseName as string,
		DatabaseId as integer,
		SchemaName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	stagingSchemaName: 'dbo',
	saveOrder: 10000,
	insertable:true,
	deletable:false,
	upsertable:false,
	updateable:false,
	keys:[],
	mapColumn(
		TableName,
		ColumnName,
		TableColumnValueFlag,
		IsNullable = IS_NULLABLE,
		DatabaseName,
		DatabaseId,
		SchemaName)) ~> DSTTempPhysicalITem
